vivento-cards.TITLE: Vivento Cards
vivento-cards.DESCRIPTION: Vivento Cards is a commercial interactive digital invitation suite launched to production and deployed live under custom vivento.day subdomains (such as christmas-card-one.vivento.day and wedding-card-one.vivento.day). Powered by a unified single-repository architecture with a shared core engine and lazy-loaded visual templates, it features private token-based guest access, multi-step RSVP with companion and menu selection, countdown timers with .ics export, interactive venue maps, a moderated collaborative photo gallery, and a protected admin dashboard with live customization plus PDF and Excel reporting. Built through AI-assisted development using React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, ExcelJS, jsPDF, and Supabase (100% relational PostgreSQL with RLS, secure RPCs, Auth, and Storage), and hosted in production on Vercel.

clausulamesta.TITLE: Clausulamesta
clausulamesta.DESCRIPTION: Production web application for LALIGA Fantasy managers, live at clausulamesta.club with $0 infrastructure cost. It combines a daily market tracker (~650 players with prices and trends), a side-by-side 5-player comparator with shareable links, LaLiga standings and rankings, and interactive loan and release-clause calculators. Built through AI-assisted development using a lightweight zero-dependency architecture (HTML5, CSS3, Vanilla JavaScript) as an installable PWA, powered by automated Node.js data pipelines and daily Telegram summaries via GitHub Actions, and deployed on GitHub Pages with a custom domain and full technical SEO.

trello-clone.TITLE: Trello Clone
trello-clone.DESCRIPTION: Clone of the Trello application (under construction) has 3 pages so far: Login, Boards, and Board. Built with Angular and TailwindCSS, it also makes use of the Angular CDK to use directives and agnostic components like Drag and Drop, Overlays, Accordion and more...

crypto-chatbot.TITLE: Crypto Chatbot
crypto-chatbot.DESCRIPTION: Chatbot integrated into META Messenger that provides cryptocurrency information with simple and detailed indicators, in addition to just prices. Modeled and trained using Wit.ai, built with javascript, hosted on ngrok, and connected to Messenger using META for Developers.

to-do-app.TITLE: To Do App
to-do-app.DESCRIPTION: To do application developed with React, following a design pattern inspired by FreeCodeCamp. A task can be created, edited and deleted. It also has an integrated router using React Router Dom. And the tasks persist using Localstorage. Hosted on Github Pages.
